title: Root N1 over R_6 with one right sibling, signed as the root of 8 leaves

sentences.text: The `anchor` MUST be the root of the subtree covering transactions `T[m - 2^t], ..., T[m - 1]`, where `2^t` is the largest power of two dividing `m`; when `m` is a power of two, the anchor is `R_m`.
Neither tree size is needed for verification.

reading_b_size_free.rule_text: the size-free checks B1 to B13 hold; this does not establish 0 < m < n or the canonical anchor position

tree_sizes_note: older_size: the size of the ledger tree whose root older_root is; newer_size: the seqno of the receipt's ccf.v1 txid 2.8, the tree size its signature covers as measured on CCF 7.0.17 with leaf 0 counted (not stated by -05)

reading_b_size_aware.rule_text: 4: the anchor MUST and 0 < m < n with the tree sizes older_size m and newer_size n: 0 < m < n, and the tags equal those of RFC 9162 2.1.4.1 for m and n (for a proof that does not start from older_root, for some m' below n); with m alone, the proof from older_root has popcount(m) - 1 left siblings

construction: anchor R_6 of the ledger's first 6 leaves, one right sibling node(6, 8); N1 = HASH(R_6 || node(6, 8)) is the root of no tree of the section 2.1 shape, so no service signs it; the test key signs it with the txid 2.8, as a service would sign the root of 8 leaves. Without sizes the proof has the form of a canonical proof from 4 to 5

provenance.note: signed with TEST_ONLY_es384_private_key.pem; no service signs this root
provenance.ledger: scitt-ccf-ledger 00101f769d872711356e080fbb089ac48589c60a, CCF 7.0.17, virtual mode, one node, local; not a production service
